# AiMessage

An assistant reply, marked as AI by the small AI icon at its start (named "AI" for assistive technology), so no answer reads as a person's. The content is `text`, or `parts` when a reply mixes text with other content: a part is `{ type: 'text', text }` or any other `{ type, ... }`, which `renderPart` draws. - `status="complete"` is a finished message. - `status="streaming"` is text still arriving: a caret follows the last character and the message is marked busy for assistive technology. - `status="thinking"` is the typing indicator, before any text exists. `sources` lists what a finished answer read, under the message: an answer that draws on records always shows them.

**Import:** `import { AiMessage } from '@/components';`

**Source:** `design-system/src/components/labels/AiMessage/AiMessage.jsx`

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| `text` | string | — | A single text reply; shorthand for one text part. |
| `parts` | arrayOf (required) | — | Parts of a reply, in order: `{ type: 'text', text }` or another `{ type }` that `renderPart` draws. |
| `status` | enum | `'complete'` | `complete` is finished, `streaming` is text still arriving, `thinking` is the typing indicator. |
| `typeOut` | bool | `false` | Types a finished text out character by character, as a reply that has just arrived. |
| `renderPart` | func | — | Draws a part that is not text: `(part, index) => node`. |
| `sources` | arrayOf (required) | — | What a finished answer read: one `{ title, href, type }` per source, listed under the message. |
| `className` | string | — | — |

## Variants

**`status`** — `complete` · `streaming` · `thinking`

Anything not listed is not a valid value.
